name: Naphtali (Bilhah's son)
title: Jacob's sixth son and patriarch
summary: Naphtali was the sixth son of Jacob, born to Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant. His name means 'my struggle' and was given by Rachel, who felt she had struggled and prevailed over her sister Leah. Naphtali became the patriarch of one of Israel's twelve tribes, which later settled in northern Galilee.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Naphtali
keyEvents.description: Naphtali was born to Bilhah, Rachel's servant. Rachel named him Naphtali and said: 'I have wrestled with my sister in God's struggle, and I have prevailed.'

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Naphtali traveled with his father Jacob and the rest of the family to Egypt during the famine, to be reunited with Joseph.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Blessing
keyEvents.description: On his deathbed, Jacob blessed his sons. About Naphtali he said: 'Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.'

keyEvents.title: The Descendants of Naphtali Are Counted
keyEvents.description: During the census in the wilderness, the tribe of Naphtali was counted as 53,400 men fit for military service.

keyEvents.title: Moses' Blessing over Naphtali
keyEvents.description: Before his death, Moses blessed the tribes of Israel. About Naphtali he said: 'Naphtali is abounding with favor and full of the Lord's blessing. He shall possess the sea and the south.'
